ATL.note: Over cap, under aprons; many expiring contracts offer trade flexibility. Young core.

BOS.note: Hard-capped at 1st apron with Tatum/George max deals. Limited flexibility, but strong core.

BKN.note: Significant cap space and under all aprons. Positioned to be major buyers at the trade deadline.

CHA.note: Young core with cap flexibility and large TPE. Brandon Miller returning from shoulder surgery.

CHI.note: Significant cap space and under all aprons. Positioned to be major buyers at the trade deadline.

CLE.note: Hard-capped at 2nd apron; high payroll with Mitchell, Mobley, Harden, Allen. Limited trade flexibility.

DET.note: Significant cap space and young core (Cunningham, Thompson). Positioned to be buyers at the trade deadline.

IND.note: Haliburton returns healthy. Over luxury tax and first apron, limiting trade flexibility.

MIA.note: Over luxury tax and near first apron with Giannis/Adebayo. Limited trade flexibility.

MIL.note: Over cap, under aprons; many expiring contracts and large TPE offer flexibility.

NYK.note: Over luxury tax and first apron, near second apron. Limited trade flexibility.

ORL.note: Young core, but over luxury tax and first apron. Limited trade flexibility.

PHI.note: High payroll with Embiid, George, Maxey. Over luxury tax and first apron, limiting flexibility.

TOR.note: Hard-capped at 1st apron with high payroll (Leonard, Barnes, Quickley). Limited flexibility.

WAS.note: Young core with #1 pick Dybantsa. Under luxury tax and aprons, offering flexibility.

DAL.note: Hard-capped at 1st apron with Doncic/Davis. Limited trade flexibility, some exceptions available.

DEN.note: Over second apron with highest payroll (Jokic, Murray, Gordon). Severely limited flexibility.

GSW.note: Hard-capped at 2nd apron, highest payroll. Key injuries (Butler, Moody) and limited flexibility.

HOU.note: Hard-capped at 2nd apron with Durant, Sengun, VanVleet. Limited trade flexibility.

LAC.note: Hard-capped at 1st apron. New core with Garland/Ingram. Some trade flexibility via TPEs.

LAL.note: Doncic era. Over luxury tax, near first apron. Limited trade flexibility.

MEM.note: Cap space, young core, and large TPE. Morant, Clarke, Edey return healthy.

MIN.note: Hard-capped at 2nd apron with Edwards, Ball, Gobert. Severely limited trade flexibility.

NOP.note: Strong core (Zion, Poole, Murray). Under luxury tax and aprons, some flexibility.

OKC.note: Strong young core (SGA, Holmgren, Williams). Over luxury tax and first apron, limiting flexibility.

PHX.note: Over luxury tax and first apron with Booker, Green, Bridges. Limited trade flexibility.

POR.note: Hard-capped at 1st apron. Young core with Morant. Lillard returning from Achilles tear.

SAC.note: Hard-capped at 1st apron. Solid core (LaVine, Sabonis). Future cap space in 2027.

SAS.note: Deep young core (Wemby, Castle, Harper). Hard-capped at 1st apron, managed future flexibility.

UTA.note: Strong core (Jackson Jr., Markkanen). Under luxury tax and aprons, offering trade flexibility.
